subject: Re: [External Sender] Re: POC Contract Question
text:
Hi Alex,
We generally do not pay for a POC agreement even in instances where a
supplier provides a "hands on keyboard" resource.
We believe that the costs for a POC are part of the marketing cost incurred
by suppliers.
Additionally, payment adds additional contract language, requires the
supplier to be setup in our accounting system & delays the process to get
an agreement in place.

If a payment is absolutely necessary, we'll need to get approval from
leadership, finance and we'll need to get our contracts team to include the
additional contractual language.
The amount of $100K also appears high for a short POC with no dedicated
resource being provided by Encord.
Would you be able to provide an itemized breakdown of the cost?

Please advise if we need to have a call to discuss further.

Thanks,
Abhay
